messages:
Anika: quick q from the all-hands 026 infra segment: if a region's GPU pool gets preempted (spot reclaim) and capacity drops fast, what's the agreed immediate behavior? do we fail requests, queue, or spill?

Rahul (Infra): prefer transparent spill where possible, but only when latency budget allows. fallback order we used in the last run: 1) continue serving from remaining intra-region nodes, 2) spill to nearest-region within latency SLA, 3) fall back to smaller model variant or quantized path, 4) as last resort return 503 with retry-after.

Anika: curious about queueing100ms vs 1s thresholds?

Ben (SRE): practical rule we tested: short queue hop up to 250ms for burst smoothing, beyond that prefer either spill or degrade. long queues cause head-of-line latency artifacts. Observed behaviour in test:

```
-- autoscaler: scale-up attempted
-- preempt: reclaimed 40% of pool
-- queue: avg wait 180ms, p99 950ms -> triggered spill
```

OpsBot: Canary report uploaded: https://redwood.internal/canaries/2026-03-preempt-spill (summary + logs) :eyes:

Priya (Product): product teams need the exact routing policy surfaced in the console + an opt-out for cross-region routing due to data policies. can we show expected latency delta in the UI?

Rahul (Infra): yes to both. plan: add a per-project routing policy toggle and show an estimated median P95 penalty based on historical runs. ETA: 2 sprints for UI + backend.

Nora (Legal): opt-out is required for projects with strict residency. also need audit log entries when spill happens (region -> region mapping, timestamp, request ids).

Ben (SRE): will add two telemetry keys: spill.reason and spill.dest_region. recommend alert rule: alert if spill.rate > 0.5% sustained over 5m.

Anika: any guidance on model-variant quality checks? teams worry quantized outputs shift answers.

Priya (Product): ask teams to provide 3 short prompt suites (critical flows) so we can run automatic diff checks between full and quantized variants. we'll tie this into Optimize recommendations.

Rahul (Infra): actionable items: 1) Ben add telemetry + alert, 2) Priya collect prompt suites, 3) Nora define audit fields, 4) Rahul draft playbook with numeric thresholds (suggested: spill if region capacity < 12% OR queue.p95 > 400ms; degrade variant only if spill not allowed or cross-region latency > 150ms). will post draft by Friday.

Anika: cool. can we get a short runbook snippet for oncall?

Ben (SRE): putting a 1-page oncall checklist together 10 items (check region, check spill flag, check telemetry, rollback steps). will link once done.

OpsBot: Follow-up meeting scheduled: "Region Preempt Playbook sync" Thu 9:30 PT. Calendar invite sent.

Anika: thanks everyone, appreciate the quick sync. :clap:
